name: jarvis-agents
description: JARVIS — a local desktop app where Claude builds and Codex tests your code
author: JARVIS

scripts.dist: node design/build.cjs && node design/skins.cjs && electron design/make-assets.cjs && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.test: node --test test/orchestrator.test.js test/regressions.test.js test/limit.test.js test/providers.test.js test/features.test.js test/extensions.test.js test/voice.test.js test/offline.test.js test/cc.test.js test/talks.test.js test/bot.test.js test/tasks.test.js test/workflows.test.js test/agents-kit.test.js test/license.test.js test/mobile.test.js test/club.test.js test/pc.test.js test/voice-cloud.test.js test/kimi.test.js test/agy.test.js test/terminal.test.js test/notices.test.js test/access.test.js test/learn.test.js test/split.test.js test/memory.test.js test/skills-make.test.js test/mail.test.js test/pc-agent.test.js test/mini-agent.test.js test/video-skill.test.js test/ext-search.test.js test/arena.test.js test/audit.test.js test/budget.test.js test/resume.test.js
scripts.release: npm version patch -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
